# Advanced Methods and Artificial Intelligence

Student presentations in this chapter concern advanced computational methods,
deep learning, natural-language processing, and artificial intelligence.

+-----------------------+--------------+--------------------------------------+
| Presentation          | Presenter    | Description                          |
+=======================+==============+======================================+
| [LLM Agents][parkins] | Jack Parkins | Explains how an LLM agent answers a  |
|                       |              | data question by calling tools in a  |
|                       |              | loop, using a scripted teaching      |
|                       |              | example (pre-written model turns,    |
|                       |              | real tools) on simulated stock data. |
|                       |              | Covers failure modes and how to      |
|                       |              | evaluate an agent with a binomial    |
|                       |              | model and Wilson intervals.          |
+-----------------------+--------------+--------------------------------------+
